picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and James Collins won the prestigious Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark validation of AI's growing role in solving the global antibiotic-resistance crisis.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to 5% of its shares (potentially $100 billion) to the public, alongside SpaceX's equity moves, raises major questions about how AI-driven wealth should be distributed and regulated going forward.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5 million NSF-funded national infrastructure project to secure AI-driven scientific research across institutions.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team's AI-guided vaccine design technique achieved complete protection against diverse circulating bird flu variants in trials, demonstrating AI's potential to accelerate defenses against emerging pandemic threats.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5 million ARPA-H consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to develop AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke treatment, a major cross-sector push into AI-driven medical devices.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC's strategic framework agreement to advance AI and financial innovation signals deepening ties between major financial institutions and academic AI research.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will combine satellite imaging, health data, and AI to investigate environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, a significant funded effort on a major public health question.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding will help ANU modernize a widely used fusion simulation tool with AI, an example of big tech capital accelerating progress toward practical fusion energy.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills purely from self-generated synthetic data, a notable scientific finding that could reduce AI's dependence on scarce real-world training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: ASU's $3.2 million NIH-funded project uses deep learning on retinal images and blood biomarkers to screen for preclinical Alzheimer's disease, advancing early, non-invasive detection methods.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s
